turns.text: I am happy to help you.
It makes the other person feel comfortable like oh thank you and you can say no problem it was easy.
turns.zh: 这样会让对方觉得舒服，就像「哦，谢谢」，然后你可以说「没问题，小事一桩」。

turns.text: So yeah sure no problem is a great common way to accept but there are other phrases we can use too.
turns.zh: 所以对，当然，「没问题」是接受感谢时很常见的好说法，但我们也可以用别的表达。

turns.text: Another one is simply of course.
turns.zh: 另一个就是简单说「当然」。

turns.text: It might sound too simple, but it is a very common and polite way to say yes to a favor.
turns.zh: 这听起来可能太简单了，但它是回应别人求助时非常常见又礼貌的说法。
